text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday. I have prepared a 
supreme-grade glasses cloth for your 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Crafting high-quality eyewear accessories 
for 50 years. With solid expertise, highly 
acclaimed in the industry—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"A quick wipe makes your lens good as 
new." That's Australian UMACO, right? I 
was just looking to replace mine. Thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To think you're already using one... 
impressive. Could you perhaps also have 
the "Unbreakable Even If an Elephant Steps 
on It" UMAHASHE glasses case as well?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's a must-have when traveling overseas. 
Even buried under luggage, it protected my 
glasses without fail.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And wearing these domestic Umastail nose 
pads has made my QOL skyrocket!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I completely agree! Even with the minor 
updates on the new model, the fit while 
running is just irresistible!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you really know your stuff! You must 
be quite the connoisseur, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, glasses are the absolute fundamental 
of self-producing... I could talk about 
them forever, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is shaping up to be a 
passionate birthday!
